description: Dondero Loop, a lifelong Nevadan, is running for State Senate because she wants to continue the work she began in the Assembly, like fighting to make our public schools better and working to bring good-paying jobs to Nevada. She is committed to making sure the citizens of our state have every opportunity to succeed.
